## project/.opencode/hooks/opencode-events.js
// V2 reports a turn through its execution events. The tool hook is where a finished call's
// result can change, so a hook's answer lands in the result the model reads.
function eventsForV2(event, directory) {
  const data = event?.data;
  if (typeof data?.sessionID !== "string") return [];
  if (event.type === "session.created") {
    return [
      {
        type: "session.created",
        properties: {
          info: { id: data.sessionID, directory: data.location?.directory ?? directory },
        },
      },
    ];
  }
  if (
    event.type === "session.execution.succeeded" ||
    event.type === "session.execution.failed" ||
    event.type === "session.execution.interrupted"
  ) {
    if (event.type === "session.execution.interrupted" && data.reason === "shutdown") return [];
    return [
      {
        type: "session.idle",
        properties: { sessionID: data.sessionID, directory: event.location?.directory },
      },
    ];
  }
  return [];
}

// A string result takes the answer after a blank line; a list of parts takes a text part.
function withAnswer(content, answer) {
  if (Array.isArray(content)) return [...content, { type: "text", text: answer }];
  return content ? `${content}\n\n${answer}` : answer;
}

export async function setupOpencodeEvents(ctx, factory) {
  // OpenCode 1.19 also calls setup with its early V2 context, which has no location, while
  // server() already serves that host.
  if (ctx.location === undefined) return;
  const controller = new AbortController();
  // A Stop script's block becomes the session's next prompt, sent through the V2 session API.
  const client = {
    session: {
      prompt: ({ path, body }) =>
        ctx.session.prompt({
          sessionID: path.id,
          text: body.parts.map((part) => part.text).join("\n"),
        }),
    },
  };
  const hooks = await factory({ directory: ctx.location.directory, client });
  const toolHook = await ctx.tool.hook("execute.after", async (call) => {
    if (call.status !== "completed" || !call.result) return;
    const output = { output: "" };
    await hooks["tool.execute.after"]({ tool: call.tool, sessionID: call.sessionID, args: call.input }, output);
    const answer = output.output.trim();
    if (answer) call.result.content = withAnswer(call.result.content, answer);
  });
  // The subscription lives until cleanup. Awaiting it here would block plugin startup.
  void (async () => {
    try {
      for await (const event of ctx.event.subscribe({ signal: controller.signal })) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) break;
        for (const mapped of eventsForV2(event, ctx.location.directory)) {
          await hooks.event({ event: mapped });
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Stream failures and cancellation must not reject into the host.
      controller.abort();
    }
  })();
  return async () => {
    controller.abort();
    await toolHook.dispose();
  };
}


## project/.opencode/plugin/aidd-context-hooks.js
// Generated by aidd - do not edit by hand. OpenCode's plugin loader scans no "hooks" family,
// so this file is the only trigger this plugin's declared hooks have on OpenCode.
import { setupOpencodeEvents } from "../hooks/opencode-events.js";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

// Never process.execPath: OpenCode ships as its own standalone binary - that path names `opencode`
// itself, not a Node runtime able to run this plugin's own hook scripts.
const HOOKS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("../hooks/aidd-context/", import.meta.url));

const SESSION_START = [{"script":"memory.cjs","args":["load"]},{"script":"artifacts.cjs","args":["start"]}];
const POST_TOOL_USE = [{"script":"artifacts.cjs","args":["mark"],"tools":["write","edit","bash","shell","bash","powershell","apply_patch"]}];
const STOP = [{"script":"memory.cjs","args":["sync"]}];
const PRE_TOOL_USE = [];
const USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT = [];

function reportHookFailure(script, error) {
  console.warn("[aidd] OpenCode hook " + script + " failed: " + String(error));
}

function exitDescription(code, signal) {
  return "exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")");
}

/** Runs one hook script under node from the plugin's scripts folder, in the payload's directory,
 * with its payload on stdin, and collects what it wrote. */
function runCapture(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const failed = (error) => resolve({ error, code: null, signal: null, stdout: "", stderr: "" });
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    try {
      const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
        cwd: directory,
        stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
        timeout: 5000,
      });
      child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
        stdout += chunk;
      });
      child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
        stderr += chunk;
      });
      // A spawn that never launches emits both an error and a close: the first settles it.
      child.on("error", failed);
      child.on("close", (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal, stdout, stderr }));
      // A script that never reads its stdin must not throw.
      child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
      child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
    } catch (error) {
      // An argument spawn refuses (a NUL byte) throws before any child exists.
      failed(error);
    }
  });
}

/** The JSON a script printed on stdout, or an empty object when it printed none. */
function stdoutJson(stdout) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(stdout) ?? {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/** What a script printed for the person, never the model. */
function personOf(output) {
  return String(output?.systemMessage ?? "").trim();
}

const NO_ANSWER = { text: "", person: "", required: false };

/** `required` is what the adapter prints for a finding the model must deal with before going on. */
function answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr) {
  if (code === 2) return { text: stderr.trim(), person: "", required: false };
  if (code !== 0) return NO_ANSWER;
  const output = stdoutJson(stdout);
  return {
    text: String(output?.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext ?? output?.additionalContext ?? "").trim(),
    person: personOf(output),
    required: output?.required === true,
  };
}

/** A script that fails to run, or exits other than 0 or 2, is reported and answers nothing. */
function answerOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ error, code, signal, stdout, stderr }) => {
    if (error !== undefined) {
      reportHookFailure(script, error);
      return NO_ANSWER;
    }
    if ((code !== 0 && code !== 2) || signal !== null) {
      reportHookFailure(script, exitDescription(code, signal));
      return NO_ANSWER;
    }
    return answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr);
  });
}

/** A Stop script's {"decision":"block","reason"} on stdout: the reason to keep working on. */
function stopReasonOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ error, code, stdout }) => {
    if (error !== undefined || code !== 0) return { reason: "", person: "" };
    const output = stdoutJson(stdout);
    const reason = output?.decision === "block" ? String(output.reason ?? "").trim() : "";
    return { reason, person: personOf(output) };
  });
}

function stopCallsFor(sessionId, directory) {
  return STOP.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: { hook_event_name: "Stop", session_id: sessionId, cwd: directory },
  }));
}

const FOLLOW_UP = { aidd: "stop-follow-up" };
const FINDING = { aidd: "finding" };

function isBridgePrompt(parts) {
  return parts.some((part) => typeof part?.metadata?.aidd === "string");
}

function sendPrompt(client, method, sessionId, text, mark, script, failure) {
  return client.session[method]({ path: { id: sessionId }, body: { parts: [{ type: "text", text, metadata: mark }] } })
    .catch((error) => reportHookFailure(script, failure + String(error)));
}

function matchesTool(tools, tool) {
  return !tools || tools.includes(tool.toLowerCase());
}

/** Pure: a tool call -> every hook of one event whose matcher allows its tool. The host names the
 * written file `filePath`; the scripts read Claude Code's `file_path`. */
function toolUseCallsFor(event, hooks, call, args, directory) {
  const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
  const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
  return hooks.filter((hook) => matchesTool(hook.tools, tool)).map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: event,
      session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      tool_name: tool,
      tool_input: toolInput,
    },
  }));
}

/** A call about to run: the host hands the arguments in the output, not in the call. */
function preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, directory) {
  return toolUseCallsFor("PreToolUse", PRE_TOOL_USE, call, output?.args, directory);
}

/** A call that ran. */
function postToolUseCallsFor(call, directory) {
  return toolUseCallsFor("PostToolUse", POST_TOOL_USE, call, call?.args, directory);
}

/** The reason the first script that refuses gave, or null when none does. */
async function refusalOf(calls) {
  for (const call of calls) {
    const { code, stderr } = await runCapture(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
    if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

/** The refusal is thrown out of the host's hook, the one way it stops the call. */
async function refuseToolUse(call, output, directory) {
  let refusal = null;
  try {
    refusal = await refusalOf(preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, directory));
  } catch (error) {
    reportHookFailure("PreToolUse", error);
  }
  if (refusal !== null) throw new Error(refusal);
}

/** Each PostToolUse answer is appended to the output the model reads, its message for the person
 * handed to `show` where the host has one, a failure reported. An answer the script marks
 * required is also queued as the session's next prompt, which the model takes up after the current
 * step; not awaited, so the host's prompt call never holds the tool. */
async function addToolAnswers(call, output, directory, client, show) {
  try {
    for (const hook of postToolUseCallsFor(call, directory)) {
      const { text, person, required } = await answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, hook.payload, directory);
      show?.(person);
      if (!text) continue;
      output.output = (output.output ?? "") + "\n\n" + text;
      if (required) sendPrompt(client, "promptAsync", call?.sessionID, text, FINDING, hook.script, "finding not queued: ");
    }
  } catch (error) {
    reportHookFailure("PostToolUse", error);
  }
}

/** Pure: the user's message -> every UserPromptSubmit hook's call, none for a prompt a bridge
 * sent. The text is the user's own: a part another hook added is not. */
function userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory) {
  const parts = output?.parts ?? [];
  if (isBridgePrompt(parts)) return [];
  const prompt = parts
    .filter((part) => part?.type === "text" && !part.synthetic)
    .map((part) => part.text)
    .join("\n");
  return USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: "UserPromptSubmit",
      session_id: input?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      prompt,
    },
  }));
}

/** Each answer becomes a synthetic text part after the user's, its id derived from the first
 * part's, this plugin's name and the hook's place in its list, so no two parts share one. */
async function addPromptContext(input, output, directory) {
  try {
    const calls = userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory);
    for (const [index, call] of calls.entries()) {
      const { text } = await answerOf(call.script, call.args, call.payload, directory);
      if (!text) continue;
      output.parts.push({
        id: output.parts[0].id + "-" + "aidd-context" + "-" + index,
        messageID: output.message?.id,
        sessionID: input?.sessionID,
        type: "text",
        text,
        synthetic: true,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    reportHookFailure("UserPromptSubmit", error);
  }
}

const sessions = new Map();

function runSessionStart(event, fallbackDirectory) {
  const named = event?.properties?.sessionID;
  if (typeof named !== "string") return;
  if (event.type === "session.deleted") {
    sessions.delete(named);
    continuedTurns.delete(named);
    return;
  }
  if (sessions.has(named)) return;
  const directory = event.properties.info?.directory ?? fallbackDirectory;
  const answers = SESSION_START.map((hook) =>
    answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, { hook_event_name: "SessionStart", session_id: named, cwd: directory }, directory)
  );
  const joined = (texts) => texts.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
  sessions.set(named, {
    directory,
    started: Promise.all(answers).then((all) => ({
      context: joined(all.map((answer) => answer.text)),
      person: joined(all.map((answer) => answer.person)),
    })),
  });
}

/** The folder a session's hooks run in. */
function sessionDirectory(sessionId, fallbackDirectory) {
  return sessions.get(sessionId)?.directory ?? fallbackDirectory;
}

/** What SessionStart answered, added to the system prompt of the session's turn; its message for
 * the person handed to `show` once, where the host has one. */
async function addSessionContext(input, output, show) {
  const started = await sessions.get(input?.sessionID)?.started;
  if (started === undefined) return;
  if (started.context) output.system.push(started.context);
  const person = started.person;
  started.person = "";
  show?.(person);
}

const continuedTurns = new Set();

function noteTurn(sessionId, parts) {
  if (!isFollowUp(parts)) continuedTurns.delete(sessionId);
}

function isFollowUp(parts) {
  return parts.some((part) => part?.metadata?.aidd === FOLLOW_UP.aidd);
}

/** Resolves once the scripts ran, with the follow-ups still in flight: the prompt is the session's
 * next turn, and the turn end must not hold it. */
async function runStop(sessionId, directory, { client, method, show }) {
  const active = continuedTurns.has(sessionId);
  const sends = [];
  for (const call of stopCallsFor(sessionId, directory)) {
    const payload = { ...call.payload, stop_hook_active: active };
    const { reason, person } = await stopReasonOf(call.script, call.args, payload, directory);
    show?.(person);
    if (!reason) continue;
    continuedTurns.add(sessionId);
    sends.push(sendPrompt(client, method, sessionId, reason, FOLLOW_UP, call.script, "follow-up not delivered: "));
  }
  return sends;
}

function bridgeHooks({ directory, client, followUp, endsTurn, show, track }) {
  const folderOf = (sessionId) => sessionDirectory(sessionId, directory);
  return {
    event: async ({ event }) => {
      try {
        runSessionStart(event, directory);
        const sessionId = event?.properties?.sessionID;
        if (typeof sessionId !== "string" || !endsTurn(event)) return;
        const stopping = runStop(sessionId, folderOf(sessionId), { client, method: followUp, show });
        track?.(stopping.then((sends) => Promise.all(sends)));
        await stopping;
      } catch (error) {
        reportHookFailure("event", error);
      }
    },
    "experimental.chat.system.transform": (input, output) => addSessionContext(input, output, show),
    "chat.message": async (input, output) => {
      try {
        noteTurn(input?.sessionID, output?.parts ?? []);
      } catch (error) {
        reportHookFailure("event", error);
      }
      await addPromptContext(input, output, folderOf(input?.sessionID));
    },
    "tool.execute.before": (call, output) => refuseToolUse(call, output, folderOf(call?.sessionID)),
    "tool.execute.after": (call, output) =>
      addToolAnswers(call, output, folderOf(call?.sessionID), client, show),
  };
}

/** The person's message goes to the TUI's toast. Never awaited: the call comes back only once the
 * server is up, and a toast the TUI cannot show is not worth holding a hook for. */
function showToast(client, person) {
  if (!person) return;
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(() => client.tui.showToast({ body: { message: person, variant: "warning" } }))
    .catch(() => {});
}

export const AiddContextHooks = async (input) => {
  // Stop handlings in flight: `opencode run` exits once the session is idle, so dispose waits.
  let pending = Promise.resolve();
  // OpenCode keeps delivering events to an instance it disposed once it has created the next one.
  let disposed = false;
  const hooks = bridgeHooks({
    directory: input.directory,
    client: input.client,
    followUp: "prompt",
    endsTurn: (event) => event.type === "session.idle",
    show: (person) => showToast(input.client, person),
    track: (handling) => {
      pending = Promise.all([pending, handling]).then(() => {});
    },
  });
  return {
    ...hooks,
    dispose: async () => {
      disposed = true;
      await pending;
    },
    event: async (payload) => {
      if (!disposed) await hooks.event(payload);
    },
  };
};

export default {
  id: "aidd-context-hooks",
  server: AiddContextHooks,
  setup: (ctx) => setupOpencodeEvents(ctx, AiddContextHooks),
};


## project/.opencode/plugin/aidd-telemetry-hooks.js
// Generated by aidd - do not edit by hand. OpenCode's plugin loader scans no "hooks" family,
// so this file is the only trigger this plugin's declared hooks have on OpenCode.
import { setupOpencodeEvents } from "../hooks/opencode-events.js";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

// Never process.execPath: OpenCode ships as its own standalone binary - that path names `opencode`
// itself, not a Node runtime able to run this plugin's own hook scripts.
const HOOKS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("../hooks/aidd-telemetry/", import.meta.url));

const SESSION_START = [{"script":"task.cjs","args":["remind"]},{"script":"ledger.cjs","args":["ingest"]}];
const POST_TOOL_USE = [];
const STOP = [];
const PRE_TOOL_USE = [];
const USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT = [];

function reportHookFailure(script, error) {
  console.warn("[aidd] OpenCode hook " + script + " failed: " + String(error));
}

function exitDescription(code, signal) {
  return "exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")");
}

/** Runs one hook script under node from the plugin's scripts folder, in the payload's directory,
 * with its payload on stdin, and collects what it wrote. */
function runCapture(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const failed = (error) => resolve({ error, code: null, signal: null, stdout: "", stderr: "" });
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    try {
      const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
        cwd: directory,
        stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
        timeout: 5000,
      });
      child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
        stdout += chunk;
      });
      child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
        stderr += chunk;
      });
      // A spawn that never launches emits both an error and a close: the first settles it.
      child.on("error", failed);
      child.on("close", (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal, stdout, stderr }));
      // A script that never reads its stdin must not throw.
      child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
      child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
    } catch (error) {
      // An argument spawn refuses (a NUL byte) throws before any child exists.
      failed(error);
    }
  });
}

/** The JSON a script printed on stdout, or an empty object when it printed none. */
function stdoutJson(stdout) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(stdout) ?? {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/** What a script printed for the person, never the model. */
function personOf(output) {
  return String(output?.systemMessage ?? "").trim();
}

const NO_ANSWER = { text: "", person: "", required: false };

/** `required` is what the adapter prints for a finding the model must deal with before going on. */
function answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr) {
  if (code === 2) return { text: stderr.trim(), person: "", required: false };
  if (code !== 0) return NO_ANSWER;
  const output = stdoutJson(stdout);
  return {
    text: String(output?.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext ?? output?.additionalContext ?? "").trim(),
    person: personOf(output),
    required: output?.required === true,
  };
}

/** A script that fails to run, or exits other than 0 or 2, is reported and answers nothing. */
function answerOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ error, code, signal, stdout, stderr }) => {
    if (error !== undefined) {
      reportHookFailure(script, error);
      return NO_ANSWER;
    }
    if ((code !== 0 && code !== 2) || signal !== null) {
      reportHookFailure(script, exitDescription(code, signal));
      return NO_ANSWER;
    }
    return answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr);
  });
}

/** A Stop script's {"decision":"block","reason"} on stdout: the reason to keep working on. */
function stopReasonOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ error, code, stdout }) => {
    if (error !== undefined || code !== 0) return { reason: "", person: "" };
    const output = stdoutJson(stdout);
    const reason = output?.decision === "block" ? String(output.reason ?? "").trim() : "";
    return { reason, person: personOf(output) };
  });
}

function stopCallsFor(sessionId, directory) {
  return STOP.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: { hook_event_name: "Stop", session_id: sessionId, cwd: directory },
  }));
}

const FOLLOW_UP = { aidd: "stop-follow-up" };
const FINDING = { aidd: "finding" };

function isBridgePrompt(parts) {
  return parts.some((part) => typeof part?.metadata?.aidd === "string");
}

function sendPrompt(client, method, sessionId, text, mark, script, failure) {
  return client.session[method]({ path: { id: sessionId }, body: { parts: [{ type: "text", text, metadata: mark }] } })
    .catch((error) => reportHookFailure(script, failure + String(error)));
}

function matchesTool(tools, tool) {
  return !tools || tools.includes(tool.toLowerCase());
}

/** Pure: a tool call -> every hook of one event whose matcher allows its tool. The host names the
 * written file `filePath`; the scripts read Claude Code's `file_path`. */
function toolUseCallsFor(event, hooks, call, args, directory) {
  const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
  const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
  return hooks.filter((hook) => matchesTool(hook.tools, tool)).map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: event,
      session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      tool_name: tool,
      tool_input: toolInput,
    },
  }));
}

/** A call about to run: the host hands the arguments in the output, not in the call. */
function preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, directory) {
  return toolUseCallsFor("PreToolUse", PRE_TOOL_USE, call, output?.args, directory);
}

/** A call that ran. */
function postToolUseCallsFor(call, directory) {
  return toolUseCallsFor("PostToolUse", POST_TOOL_USE, call, call?.args, directory);
}

/** The reason the first script that refuses gave, or null when none does. */
async function refusalOf(calls) {
  for (const call of calls) {
    const { code, stderr } = await runCapture(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
    if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

/** The refusal is thrown out of the host's hook, the one way it stops the call. */
async function refuseToolUse(call, output, directory) {
  let refusal = null;
  try {
    refusal = await refusalOf(preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, directory));
  } catch (error) {
    reportHookFailure("PreToolUse", error);
  }
  if (refusal !== null) throw new Error(refusal);
}

/** Each PostToolUse answer is appended to the output the model reads, its message for the person
 * handed to `show` where the host has one, a failure reported. An answer the script marks
 * required is also queued as the session's next prompt, which the model takes up after the current
 * step; not awaited, so the host's prompt call never holds the tool. */
async function addToolAnswers(call, output, directory, client, show) {
  try {
    for (const hook of postToolUseCallsFor(call, directory)) {
      const { text, person, required } = await answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, hook.payload, directory);
      show?.(person);
      if (!text) continue;
      output.output = (output.output ?? "") + "\n\n" + text;
      if (required) sendPrompt(client, "promptAsync", call?.sessionID, text, FINDING, hook.script, "finding not queued: ");
    }
  } catch (error) {
    reportHookFailure("PostToolUse", error);
  }
}

/** Pure: the user's message -> every UserPromptSubmit hook's call, none for a prompt a bridge
 * sent. The text is the user's own: a part another hook added is not. */
function userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory) {
  const parts = output?.parts ?? [];
  if (isBridgePrompt(parts)) return [];
  const prompt = parts
    .filter((part) => part?.type === "text" && !part.synthetic)
    .map((part) => part.text)
    .join("\n");
  return USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: "UserPromptSubmit",
      session_id: input?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      prompt,
    },
  }));
}

/** Each answer becomes a synthetic text part after the user's, its id derived from the first
 * part's, this plugin's name and the hook's place in its list, so no two parts share one. */
async function addPromptContext(input, output, directory) {
  try {
    const calls = userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory);
    for (const [index, call] of calls.entries()) {
      const { text } = await answerOf(call.script, call.args, call.payload, directory);
      if (!text) continue;
      output.parts.push({
        id: output.parts[0].id + "-" + "aidd-telemetry" + "-" + index,
        messageID: output.message?.id,
        sessionID: input?.sessionID,
        type: "text",
        text,
        synthetic: true,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    reportHookFailure("UserPromptSubmit", error);
  }
}

const sessions = new Map();

function runSessionStart(event, fallbackDirectory) {
  const named = event?.properties?.sessionID;
  if (typeof named !== "string") return;
  if (event.type === "session.deleted") {
    sessions.delete(named);
    continuedTurns.delete(named);
    return;
  }
  if (sessions.has(named)) return;
  const directory = event.properties.info?.directory ?? fallbackDirectory;
  const answers = SESSION_START.map((hook) =>
    answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, { hook_event_name: "SessionStart", session_id: named, cwd: directory }, directory)
  );
  const joined = (texts) => texts.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
  sessions.set(named, {
    directory,
    started: Promise.all(answers).then((all) => ({
      context: joined(all.map((answer) => answer.text)),
      person: joined(all.map((answer) => answer.person)),
    })),
  });
}

/** The folder a session's hooks run in. */
function sessionDirectory(sessionId, fallbackDirectory) {
  return sessions.get(sessionId)?.directory ?? fallbackDirectory;
}

/** What SessionStart answered, added to the system prompt of the session's turn; its message for
 * the person handed to `show` once, where the host has one. */
async function addSessionContext(input, output, show) {
  const started = await sessions.get(input?.sessionID)?.started;
  if (started === undefined) return;
  if (started.context) output.system.push(started.context);
  const person = started.person;
  started.person = "";
  show?.(person);
}

const continuedTurns = new Set();

function noteTurn(sessionId, parts) {
  if (!isFollowUp(parts)) continuedTurns.delete(sessionId);
}

function isFollowUp(parts) {
  return parts.some((part) => part?.metadata?.aidd === FOLLOW_UP.aidd);
}

/** Resolves once the scripts ran, with the follow-ups still in flight: the prompt is the session's
 * next turn, and the turn end must not hold it. */
async function runStop(sessionId, directory, { client, method, show }) {
  const active = continuedTurns.has(sessionId);
  const sends = [];

    const payload = { ...call.payload, stop_hook_active: active };
    const { reason, person } = await stopReasonOf(call.script, call.args, payload, directory);
    show?.(person);
    if (!reason) continue;
    continuedTurns.add(sessionId);
    sends.push(sendPrompt(client, method, sessionId, reason, FOLLOW_UP, call.script, "follow-up not delivered: "));
  }
  return sends;
}

function bridgeHooks({ directory, client, followUp, endsTurn, show, track }) {
  const folderOf = (sessionId) => sessionDirectory(sessionId, directory);
  return {
    event: async ({ event }) => {
      try {
        runSessionStart(event, directory);
        const sessionId = event?.properties?.sessionID;
        if (typeof sessionId !== "string" || !endsTurn(event)) return;
        const stopping = runStop(sessionId, folderOf(sessionId), { client, method: followUp, show });
        track?.(stopping.then((sends) => Promise.all(sends)));
        await stopping;
      } catch (error) {
        reportHookFailure("event", error);
      }
    },
    "experimental.chat.system.transform": (input, output) => addSessionContext(input, output, show),
    "chat.message": async (input, output) => {
      try {
        noteTurn(input?.sessionID, output?.parts ?? []);
      } catch (error) {
        reportHookFailure("event", error);
      }
      await addPromptContext(input, output, folderOf(input?.sessionID));
    },
    "tool.execute.before": (call, output) => refuseToolUse(call, output, folderOf(call?.sessionID)),
    "tool.execute.after": (call, output) =>
      addToolAnswers(call, output, folderOf(call?.sessionID), client, show),
  };
}

/** The person's message goes to the TUI's toast. Never awaited: the call comes back only once the
 * server is up, and a toast the TUI cannot show is not worth holding a hook for. */
function showToast(client, person) {
  if (!person) return;
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(() => client.tui.showToast({ body: { message: person, variant: "warning" } }))
    .catch(() => {});
}

export const AiddTelemetryHooks = async (input) => {
  // Stop handlings in flight: `opencode run` exits once the session is idle, so dispose waits.
  let pending = Promise.resolve();
  // OpenCode keeps delivering events to an instance it disposed once it has created the next one.
  let disposed = false;
  const hooks = bridgeHooks({
    directory: input.directory,
    client: input.client,
    followUp: "prompt",
    endsTurn: (event) => event.type === "session.idle",
    show: (person) => showToast(input.client, person),
    track: (handling) => {
      pending = Promise.all([pending, handling]).then(() => {});
    },
  });
  return {
    ...hooks,
    dispose: async () => {
      disposed = true;
      await pending;
    },
    event: async (payload) => {
      if (!disposed) await hooks.event(payload);
    },
  };
};

export default {
